svg.title: Journey 2 · Settings Auto-Save Usual Portions & Recipe Reindexing (R2 + R3 · Era 3)
svg.desc: End-to-end journey map for Journey 2 (separate OpenSpec): auto-saving Usual portions in /profile/settings without a Save button, R2 library Search index card strictly below Usual portions (Index missing vs. Rebuild full index), R3 contextual single-recipe Reindex inside RecipeDetailSheet overflow menu, and error, conflict, plus Demo Mode guardrails.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · Journey 2 (OpenSpec: settings-portions-and-search-index)
Settings Auto-Save Portions & Recipe Reindex Journeys
No Save button on Usual portions; Search index card strictly below Usual portions (R2); contextual single-recipe reindex in RecipeDetailSheet ••• (R3).

g.text: Flow 1 · Auto-Save Usual Portions (No Save Button)
Immediate save on toggle or valid number change · Version-conflict safe
inline validation; never sends bad PUT
only surfaces inline alert on error
Flow 2 · R2 Library Reindex in /profile/settings (Strictly Below Portions)
Searchable vs. Enriched counts · Missing-only vs. Full rebuild
• Dual progress bar updates via SSE
Flow 3 · R3 Single-Recipe Reindex in Context (RecipeDetailSheet •••)
Fix 1 specific recipe without rebuilding the whole library or touching /capture
• No redundant duplicate job if pending
Flow 4 · Error, Version-Conflict & Demo Mode Guardrails
No silent failures · No manual Review gate · Honest Demo Mode
• Partner changes family size or portions first
• Demo Mode keeps lexical docs ready
and avoids external AI embedding calls
• Search index card explains Demo Mode
honestly rather than faking vector rebuilds
• Usual portions auto-save works in all modes
